queries.text: Lalande’s “Vocabulaire technique et critique de la philosophie” (French original), quoted in the author’s own Portuguese translation; translated here from his Portuguese. “(p. 763, tradução minha)” kept as the author’s statement (“my translation”). “sub. Vº” (sub verbo) rendered as “s.v.” The same applies to 18-0070 to 18-0073 and 18-0077.

“NOVA ENCICLOPÉDIA BARSA” rendered “NEW BARSA ENCYCLOPEDIA” and, in 18-0080, “GRANDE ENCICLOPÉDIA LAROUSSE CULTURAL” rendered “GREAT LAROUSSE CULTURAL ENCYCLOPEDIA” (Brazilian encyclopedias; the quotations are translated from the Portuguese). Keep consistent with the bibliography (chapter 20).
Encyclopedia quotation translated from the Portuguese; the bracketed insertions are the author’s.

The original prints the French title as "Du Fundament de l’Induction"; Lachelier's work is "Du fondement de l’induction" (1871). Corrected the spelling and kept the title in French, as in the original.
The original spells the title "Tratactus Theologico-Politicus"; corrected to Spinoza's "Tractatus Theologico-Politicus" (Latin, kept as in the original).
